items.q: And of course that's been the story of my life with her because she has, one way or another.

ctx.x: And -- yeah, she came back. She decided three months was enough, doing this and that. Somehow she'll build a fire under me and we'll do it together. And of course that's been the story of my life with her because she has, one way or another. Worked in my corner to animate me. There was a time when music was so bad I wanted to get out and sell pianos because I had an offer.
